\section{Results}\label{sec:results}

\begin{theorem}[Main]\label{thm:main}
For every $\Adv$ making $\qq$ queries, $\Pr[\G{0}^{\Adv}=1]\le \qq^2/2^n$.
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}
Combine \cref{lem:one} with \eqref{eq:hop}.
\end{proof}

\begin{table}[t]
\caption{Bounds, with a \textbf{bold} word and $\qq$ in the caption.}\label{tab:bounds}
\centering
\begin{tabular}{@{}lcr@{}}
\toprule
Setting & Bound & Tight? \\
\midrule
Classical & $\qq/N$ & yes \\
Quantum & $\qq^2/N$ & \multicolumn{1}{c}{no} \\
\multirow{2}{*}{Both} & $2\qq/N$ & \\
 & $3\qq/N$ & maybe \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\end{table}

\begin{corollary}
The bound of \cref{thm:main} is tight; see \cref{tab:bounds,fig:games}.
\end{corollary}
